text: Worker slipped on wet roof while inspecting flashlights, fell 2.5m onto gravel, fractured coccyx requiring medical treatment.
Digboi depot, tank entry permit shared with another crew, no dedicated standby person, weather turned rainy reducing visibility, rescue access blocked by flooding, isolation integrity compromised.
Stored energy in compressed gas header discharged on opening blind. Deafening noise and pressure wave. No injury but safety stand-down called.
Crane at Lumding Terminal lifted tank valve without tag line, load rotated unexpectedly near walkway, worker stepped back just in time.

Roof maintenance at Rangia, contractor used unsecured ladder. Top rung broke under load at 7m height. Worker suspended in air for 10 mins before rescue. No injury but extreme exposure. SIF trigger event.

Welding work near Duliajan pump station, neighbor's goat walked into fence and electrocuted. Dog chasing goat ran towards energized panel. Electrician disconnected power instantly, no human contact with energized parts. Near miss for electrocution.
Work order referenced closed PTW number. Workers started electrical isolation without new permit. Circuit was live but no contact made. HSE team intervened. Near miss.
Welding on active pipeline, H2S alarm triggered. Worker exposed to high concentration. Unplanned release could have caused asphyxiation or poisoning. Evacuation delayed due to communication gap.
Grinding on railing, sparks landed on nearby oil seal. No ignition but operator shocked. LOTO verified again. Near miss reported.
Ladder placed on uneven ground near H2S area, worker leaned to tighten valve, ladder tilted, fell 2m, sustained knee ligament damage.

Rangia refinery yard, mobile crane outrigger sank into soft soil during lift. Boom dipped, 300kg skid package lowered rapidly but controlled. Operator aborted lift. If outrigger fully failed, boom could have struck ground crew. No one in exclusion zone but boundary not maintained.

Contractor crew installing cable tray at Naharkatiya. Anchor bolt sheared off during tensioning, 15kg bracket fell from 12m. Missed lead man by 1 meter, struck hard hat on ground. Witness saw bolt spinning down. No injury but high-energy object release near personnel.
Contractor welding on 6" line at Duliajan without proper blanking. Sparks ignited nearby oil leak, worker on ground got flash burn to forearms, treated at camp clinic.
Drilling anchor bolts near hydrant, hammer strike hit hidden hydraulic line, spray hit face shield but no injury.
Moran site saw unauthorized entry into degasser manhole by third-party vendor, sensor indicated high H2S, vendor reversed before crossing threshold. Gas level was critical.
Day time, crossing rail track, vehicle stuck, worker pulling loose cable, hand caught, tendon injury, irrigation required.
High-pressure water pipe burst during flushing due to unisolated source. Jet impact caused deep cut on thigh of contractor. Surgical stitching performed at nearby hospital.
Blind tightened against active line due to PTW error. High velocity water jet cut through glove, deep gash on forearm, sutures at district hospital.
Technician found 5 psi residual pressure in trap during tagging check after LOTO. No PTW violation but alarm raised immediately. Near miss logged.

LOTO tag removed prematurely by another crew while capacitor bank de-energizing. Stored charge caused electric shock to worker, muscle cramps and dizziness. Admitted to local hospital for observation.
Cow herd on Jorhat Bypass Road, company van tried to overtake, sudden brake led to near skid. Passenger grabbed armrest, no injury. Driver admitted speeding to avoid traffic.
Spring loaded valve released unexpectedly while mechanic was replacing gasket. Hand grazed by moving stem, no PPE cut. Confirmed energy was not bled off.
Overhead crossing lifted too high near power line, arc flash risk imminent, load stopped just before contact, worker on ground platform exposed, no electric shock recorded.
Brazing coupling on Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline. Contractor used wrong filler rod, joint failed. Hot metal splatter burned hand. Blisters formed, antiseptic dressing and antibiotics prescribed.
Scaffold lift basket tilted slightly at Rangia, operator inside felt unstable. Hydraulic leak suspected. Work stopped immediately, no personnel below in zone.
Expired hot work permit used for welding on pipeline. Minor flash burn on hand, treated by site medic. No fire escalation.
Rangia refinery operator found unresponsive in control room, initial assessment suggested drug-induced sedation, woken with difficulty and treated for hypotension.
Valve packed with wax, lever broken off during isolation. Contractor struck on head by falling lever, minor scalp abrasion, stitched at site.
Residual pressure in small bore line released abrasive particles upon opening. Worker suffered corneal scratch in one eye. Treated with eye drops and monitored.

Hydrant crew vehicle at Rangia depot moving over speed bump too fast, a tool bag shifted and struck the driver's arm. Driver complained of wrist pain, sent to clinic, diagnosed with soft tissue injury. Vehicle was owned by contractor, driver was fatigued after 14-hour shift.
A loose crate on top of a pallet shifted during transport, nearly hitting the driver's cab during a sharp turn on the access road.
Contractor 6-wheeler on Guwahati Depot perimeter road, driver dozing off, vehicle drifted onto sidewalk. Braked hard, no one there. AC unit not working, fatigue clear warning sign ignored.
Forged PTW found during audit for hot work near gas separator. Worker cut by falling pipe while unpermitted, minor fracture to wrist. X-ray confirmed.
Employee double-checking isolation at Duliajan heard pop from gasket. Small leak, no fire. Worker used detector, confirmed low levels. No exposure, no injury, near miss situation.
Digboi: Crane outrigger settlement on soft ground, load dipped 1 meter, worker below moved clear, no strike, near miss.
Welding on 6" line without proper PTW, flash fire engulfed operator, gas cloud dispersed before explosion. Operator escaped with minor burns but high energy release noted.
Lumding Terminal truck bay loading arm uncoupling. Seal ring ejected, fuel splash on apron but not on personnel. Driver remained inside cab, HSE officer verified zero contact. Near miss recorded
Contractor stepped on a protruding nail inside the empty sump at Jorhat Bypass Road, causing a puncture wound to the sole. Wound irrigated and bandaged; worker off work for two days pending healing.
Welder near storage tank line, spark noticed popping from tank shell before PTW cancelled immediately, no fire started.

Operator missed critical alarm response due to drowsiness. Later found to be under influence of over-the-counter cold medicine mixed with alcohol. Experienced mild hypotensive episode treated at site health desk. Immediate removal from critical role and notification to HSSE coordinator. Recordable injury due to medical treatment for vitals stabilization.
Crane hook at Digboi fell from 30ft height due to latch failure, missing a crew member by 2ft and hitting the ground; shock and minor abrasions reported, but no direct impact injury.

While bolting flange on high-pressure hydrocarbon line, sudden release of H2S gas occurred due to incorrect blind plug alignment. Wind from NE pushed gas towards two employees standing close. Tox release potential high, no face shields or SCBA worn by nearby personnel.
Grinding on flare header, hot work permit expired. Flash fire at nozzle. Worker in immediate vicinity. High energy flame front could have caused fatal burns. SIF not engaged due to valve stuck.
Pipe fell from scaffold at Duliajan, hit guard rail then ground. Missed valve operator by 1 metre. No dual points of attachment used by contractor crew.
Contractor team entered Digboi sump without verifying gas test results. Sudden release of vapors caused immediate evacuation. No injuries reported but PTW violation noted.
Pressure spike observed on gauge after removing blind flange without confirming zero pressure. Hissing sound heard, no injury. Error in isolation sequence.
Contractor broke isolation on accumulator without verifying zero energy, H2S jet hit face shield but no laceration due to PPE. SIF activated but physical barrier absent initially.
Employee cut palm on a sharp bolt head inside the dead storage tank at Duliajan. Wound was cauterised and dressed on-site; worker returned to light duties next day after assessment.
Jeep on Moran lease road, hit pothole at high speed, jumped up and hit low hanging branch. Glass cracked but no breakage, driver uninjured. Rain slicked surface contributed.

Contractor welding on 6-inch carbon steel line at Duliajan gas plant during afternoon shift, gas detector failed to alarm near open hydrocarbon leak, worker suffered level 3 burn to face and neck, transported casualty to GHSP for treatment.
No gas test done before entering pump house. Worker ignited atmosphere with grinder, flash fire singed eyebrows and face. First aid insufficient, medic took over.
Roof sheeting shifted during removal at Guwahati Depot, worker held onto pipe rack. Loose material fell from 6m. PPE was compliant but coordination was lacking.
Ladder extended too high onto maintenance gantry, top rung slipped off edge, worker on 3rd rung fell 2m, fractured forearm, hospital transferred, ladder not secured at top.
Crane operator at Digboi failed to keep load clear of personnel during slew, swinging bundle of pipes over a ladder where a rigging tech was standing, causing him to jump back and strain his ankle.
Crane boom descended unexpectedly while lowering a transformer, dropping it onto the transformer pad inches from the electrician's feet.
Lifting lug cracked during pre-lift inspection, load grounded, tooling replaced before start.
Forklift lifting pipe rack at 1400 hrs. Load shifted due to wet mud, struck operator's leg. Swelling and bruising, treated in canteen clinic. No sling certified, operator untrained on load trim.
While lifting the air cooler bundle, the load swung towards the rigging crew due to strong crosswind, stopping just inches from the rigger's face.
Hot work permit expired during valve repair, supervisor stopped crew before arc ignited nearby cable insulation.

Cracked flange gasket under 200bar hydrostatic test pressure. Sudden leak created sonic boom and water hammer force. Worker in arc of projection, no injury but potential for eardrum rupture or blast trauma was real.
hot work job at Lumding Terminal: unexpected sparks near open hydrocarbon line noticed by the crew; immediate stand-down, no injuries reported.
Missing permit for scaffolding erection at height. Slight twist of ankle on uneven ground. X-ray clear but treated with ice and compression.
Suspended load of valve body dropped 2m due to shackle pin withdrawal. Hit worker's shin, deep laceration. Splice not inspected, LOTO not applied on hoist. First aid applied, no X-ray needed.
Contractor found snoring in control room during day shift. H2S alarm was testing fine but operator was unresponsive for 2 mins. No gas release detected during this period.

Tank cleaning operation, static discharge generated during entry. Residual vapour explosion potential isolated but minor shock injury to hand. Medical treatment provided for nerve damage. Contractor from Lumding Terminal storage area.
Roof access ladder detached at Digboi, worker on platform lost footing. Grabbed adjacent structure. No safety net below. TBT was not enforced for this task.
Contractor truck reversing near Digboi metering station without spotter. Vehicle struck the rear of a parked service van and crushed the attendant. Fatal head and chest injuries confirmed on scene.
Runner crane at Rangia failed to brake smoothly, load swung into pipe rack and struck a worker leaning on the rail, causing a dislocated shoulder and minor head contusion.

Scaffold leg sank into soft soil at Lumding Terminal at night. 5m platform tilted sharply, two men scrambled to roof edge. One fell 2m to catch pipe, massive impact. X-ray negative, muscle strain only. Critical near miss.
Ladder rung gave way on Digboi flare stack, worker caught himself on rail. Near fall from 4m height. LOTO was active but safety harness was not hooked off.
Lorry unloading at Lumding Terminal slipped on wet surface. Trailer swung and struck the uncontrolled loading arm. Operator was 1m away when arm collapsed. Broken ribs and lacerations.

Crane at Jorhat Bypass Road lifted pump assembly. Hook block descended unexpectedly due to hydraulic leak, 500kg load dropped 2m onto concrete. Worker nearby stepped back, dust inhalation, mild bronchitis, treated with syrup.
Grinding near open hydrocarbon spill. Flame jet reached 3 meters towards onlookers. No LOTO on adjacent line. Incident stopped when valve manually closed. No injury but high risk of fireball.

Entry into sump at Moran delayed due to low oxygen alert; once cleared, contractor tripped over a flexible hose and sprained ankle. Medical report confirms ligament strain, treated with ice and elevation.

During commissioning of new pipeline spool, pressure test failed at flange joint. High pressure jet cut through PPE and struck contractor's leg. Intense pain reported, immediate need for hospitalisation. Significant blood loss potential. Safety watchman absent from isolation point.

Contractor scaffold gang working at 10am in Duslik. Safety belt lanyard broke under load, worker dangled for 5 mins before rescue. Required stitches on back but no fracture. PTW was valid but inspection log missing for the harness.
During night shift at Moran, confined space entry permit expired 15 mins before entry, continuous monitoring not running, toxic atmosphere potential undetected, safeguard failure.

Jorhat Bypass Road pump station, sump entry carried out without proper PPE, worker wore regular shoes in oily environment, slip and fall onto submerged obstacles likely to cause severe laceration or fracture.

Crane luffing up at Duliajan site, counterweight bracket loosened. During lift of 8ft pipe, bracket detached and fell onto mud mat. Operator aware of shifting load, stopped operation. If bracket had hit head or torso, fatal. No one hurt but safeguard failure evident.
During lifting/suspended load at Digboi, a worker slipped and injured his wrist. Hospital check found no fracture; treated and released with medication.
Verbal authorization instead of written PTW for line break. Steam leak flashed, scalded face and neck. Redness and blistering, beyond first aid scope.
Pipe support lifted without tag-out, valve wheel spun unexpectedly. Water spray near operator feet but no slip. SIF not engaged, procedure deviation noted.
Contractor inhaling residual vapors inside sump leading to eye irritation and vomiting, removed from confined space immediately and treated at field medical unit.
Lumding Terminal crane operator failed to secure load properly. While lowering, steel cable parted and whip back hit rigger's face, causing laceration to left cheek requiring 5 sutures.

Pipeline pig trap opened with residual hydraulic pressure. Hydraulic fluid jet at high pressure, worker stood directly in line. No injection injury as skin intact, but potential for amputation if plate severed.

Welding on pig launcher at Duliajan without proper LOTO, pressure leak caused face shield to blow off hitting eye causing corneal abrasion. PTW was valid but isolation points were not tagged correctly.
Driver of fuel tanker was dozing off on stand 3 at midnight. Vehicle moved 5 meters before hydraulic brakes engaged. No spillage or fire risk achieved.
Rangia site witnessed a sudden gust during lifting operation causing load to drift. Worker standing below slipped and fell, resulting in dislocated shoulder and multiple cuts on forearms.
Scaffolder at Moran site used broken plank from 2nd level. Plank snapped, worker fell 3m but caught himself on lower frame. Sprained wrist, monitored for 2 hours, discharged same day.
Temporary scaffold leg buckled under load, platform tilted 45 degrees, worker inside LOTO zone, no fall due to tight space, no injury, PTW renewed yesterday.
Workman climbing manway fell 3m when bolt slipped. Hit knee hard on concrete pad. Pain and swelling, transported to civil hospital. No helmet, no belt. Weather windy, gusts reported.
While cutting flange bolts on line 301, residual pressure caused steam jet injury to hand. Employee received first aid and referred to site hospital for treatment.
Residual gas pressure in pipeline section caused valve handle to spin violently. Employee struck face by handle, nosebleed and soft tissue injury. Ambulance called for assessment.
Guwahati Depot loader reported fatigue and disorientation during shift, urine sample positive for narcotics, required medical supervision and removal from duty.

Worker at Jorhat Bypass Road found intoxicated in loading bay, attempting to bypass interlock on truck coupling. Security team stopped action before plug was withdrawn without pressure check. No injury or leak, but high potential for hydraulic crush or spray burn noted.
Concrete mixer truck reversing on Digboi lease track, earth slumped and blocked path. Driver was forced to stop, no impact with pipeline right-of-way. No injury, site cleanup initiated.
Rangia tank farm, contractor team entered storage tank for cleaning, no atmospheric test within 30 mins prior to entry, oxygen levels could have dropped below safe limit unnoticed.

Vehicle operator involved in near collision at entry gate leading to sudden braking injury. Sprained ankle requiring splinting and X-ray at local clinic. Operator failed random alcohol test conducted post-incident. Duty suspended and case referred for disciplinary action. Medical certificate obtained for injury treatment.
Contractor rigger at Digboi dropped a 50kg shackle from 3m height during crane load. Shackle struck worker's shin bone, X-ray confirmed hairline fracture, referred to hospital.
PTW issued without verifying zero energy state on pump. Mechanical seal blowout sprayed hot lube oil on technician. Heat burn treatment at site medical center.
Driver of maintenance truck was sleepy on bumpy terrain. Vehicle swerved slightly toward barricade but stayed within lane. No collision or damage reported.

PTW issued for valve maintenance but upstream pressure not bled off. Erection crew failed LOTO check, pipeline residual pressure released causing Ghee to suffer laceration to forearm. First aid applied on site, later transferred to hospital for stitching. Contractor worker from Digboi shift.

Night shift Digboi, lifting pump casing across fence line. Wind gust pushed load into exclusion zone fencing. Fencing bent, load stopped 1m before office window. No shatter. LOTO in place on adjacent unit but not relevant. Near miss recorded.

Loading arm gasket failed during connection at bowser bay. Oil spray hit operator's face and neck, causing chemical irritation and small burn. Washed out with eye wash station and treated with burn cream. Product was light crude but hot.

Shore crane operator observed disoriented and slurring words during load lift over open tank. Suspended load swung towards bund wall, potential crush hazard if operator lost grip and control entirely.

Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline expansion. Mini-crane lifting valve. Operator sightlines blocked by fuel tank trailer. Load swung into trailer frame. Metal on metal shriek. No personnel within radius, but tag line operator was 5m away. Near miss, high energy movement.
Contractor used defective step ladder, rung broke, 1.5 meter drop to ground, broken ankle suspected but no first aid required, left site immediately.
Employee slipped on wet surface inside empty storage tank and fractured left wrist during climb down ladder, PTW was valid but grounding strip not installed properly.
Expired H2S PTW used for blowdown line replacement. Sudden release caught worker in face, chemical burn to eyes and hands. Evacuated to hospital.
Torque wrench dropped from 4th platform level onto concrete deck. Tool bounced but no one nearby. LOTO not in effect for maintenance, potential crush hazard if floor below active.
Worker slipped from ladder at Jorhat Bypass Road while securing suspended valve. Fell 6m onto paved surface, broken pelvis and bleeding from ears. Admitted to trauma center.
Rigging failed during heavy lift at Guwahati Depot, dropping 300kg flange. Worker standing in exclusion zone struck, fatal skull fracture. No LOTO applied, high energy release.
Unplanned weeping from flange O-ring caused worker to lose footing on ladder. Fall from 4ft height resulted in wrist strain, X-ray done, no fracture.

Digboi station, temporary derrick used for lifting condenser. Rope slipped on winch drum, 1.5 ton load dropped 4m. Dust cloud obscured view. Two mechanics ran back 5m. If they had been standing under load, fatal. No immediate injury but near miss with high energy release.

Station wagon driven by employee on Guwahati Depot apron. Sudden brake failure led to collision with concrete pillar at 40 kmph. Passenger sustained compartmentalised skull fracture. Critical condition in ICU.
Lumding Terminal loader arm locked out incorrectly. Hydraulic pressure remained in cylinders during hose change. Contractor near miss, no injury, re-verified energy isolation.

Contractor fitter found unresponsive on platform of 10m height at 03:00 hrs. Rescued by rope team and given first aid for confusion and disorientation. Transported to hospital for observation. Preliminary test indicated presence of sedatives. Safety stand-down conducted for the crew.

During planned isolation of 6" process line, blind flange failed to seat due to worn gasket, causing high pressure steam jet towards open area. PTW incomplete for energy source verification. Contractor team standing within 3m radius had seconds to evacuate, near fatal exposure potential.

Guwahati Depot shift change overlap, crane hook left suspended with 100kg valve assembly. Wind picked up, load rotated and struck adjacent tanker truck roof. Truck driver heard bang, checked roof. If worker had walked under, fatal crush injury possible. No injuries reported.

Employee grinding flange on inactive tank d-101 at Digboi, secondary containment breach released flammable vapors, no hot work permit valid, explosion potential high but no ignition source present, near miss recorded after supervisor intervened.
Forged signature on PTW for scaffolding erection found during audit. Work halted. Suspect compromised for safety violation. No structural failure, near miss recorded.

Contractor trolley driver reversing on lease road at Naharkatiya near pump station, failed to spot pipeline marker, struck worker's shin with tire. Worker reported severe pain later, sent to hospital for X-ray, no fracture but deep bruising and swelling. PTW active but spotter was absent during initial backing maneuver.
Agri-pump vehicle reversing on Digboi internal road, rear view mirror obstructed by rain. Hit curb, no person in path. Driver fresh on duty but visibility poor due to monsoon.
Welding on empty pipeline section released trapped hydrocarbons. Strong odor detected 50m away. Work stopped, area gas tested negative after ventilation. No ignition source active at time of release.

Employee in company car overspeeding on Lumding Terminal access road, lost control on oil spill, car skidded into bollard. Driver sustained minor head bump and neck strain, hospitalized for observation. Guard was present but did not stop the vehicle earlier.
Lifting beam overloaded at Guwahati Depot slipped off support blocks, dropping 6 inches and striking a contractor's shin as he walked underneath; swelling and bruising recorded as recordable injury.

Grinding operation on structural steel near high pressure header at Jorhat Bypass Road compressor station, gas ball valve failed while open, uncontrolled release created flammable cloud, workers evacuated before ignition, no injuries, near miss with high consequence potential.
Welding on storage tank shell, ground clamp loose. Arc struck nearby pipe. No burn or fire but damaged coating. Corrective action taken.
Heavy rain in Jorhat Bypass Road area caused slip on tank access ladder, employee fell back onto platform edge, caught guardrail. No fracture, near miss confined to loss of balance.
Contractor welding on 6in pipeline at Digboi without hot work PTW. Sparks hit nearby leaking valve, small fire started, hand burn to worker requiring dressing.
Welding on empty drum inside office yard, wind blew smoke towards electrical panel, breaker tripped before contact.
Heavy rain reduced visibility on Naharkatiya access road. Forklift operator lost control while reversing near pipe rack. Machine tipped and pinned the operator's leg. Amputation below knee required.
Contractor 4x4 speeding past Digboi site gate, tire blew out causing vehicle to swerve towards water separator. No contact with assets or personnel, immediate stop and control restored.
SIF inhibit used without approved deviation or extended PTW. Isolation valve failed to close fully. Leak detected by visual check. System shut down safely. Near miss.
Spotter for reversing dumper at Rangia fell while crossing road. Dumper rear tyres rolled over his torso. Fatal crush injury to abdomen and pelvis. Body recovered after 2 hours.
Ladder slipped on wet platform surface, operator slid down 3 meters, feet braked by railing, no slip, H2S alarm silent, rain intensity moderate.

Contractor dumper truck at Guwahati Depot driving on employee walkway during night shift, struck a stumbling employee. Employee fell, fractured elbow, immediate ambulance called. Driver was fatigued, PTW for material movement expired but vehicle still on site.

5T crawler crane lifting spool piece at Duliajan, tag line not attached during swing. Load drifted 2m over walkway where two workers were standing. No PTW for hot work nearby but wind picked up suddenly. Near miss, no injury.

TBT truck attempting reversal on narrow track at Duliajan production unit, rammed into a low hanging branch which fell on operator's head. Operator sustained scalp laceration requiring suturing. Reversing alarm was working but visibility was poor due to late evening shift and rain.
Fuel tanker unloading at Guwahati Depot, fire extinguisher cart fell from hitch. Rolled 10 feet towards driver who was stepping out of cab. Driver jumped back, no injury, cart damaged.

Night shift operator at pump station found with strong alcohol smell near SIF valve. Worker reported dizziness but no impact on equipment. Supervisor escorted off site and incident logged as near miss.
Falling bolt from 12m scaffold near walkway, PTW valid but tie-off missed, no one below.
Valid PTW but missing isolation verification at Rangia, high pressure line isolated but blind flange not installed, valve leak detected during re-entry.
Worker felt sudden dizziness and mild headache after entering sump without fresh air supply, exited voluntarily and received medical observation at site clinic.
Forged gas test log for tank entry at Duliajan, safety officer intercepted team, toxic levels found upon re-testing.
Contractor tractor reversing blindly near equipment laydown area. Almost struck live cable reel. Alarm sounded but no speed limiter on vehicle. High energy potential if hit.

Employee reported dizziness before operating forklift in depot yard. Forklift tipped slightly while reversing near staircase, potential fall from height if equipment failed completely due to inattentiveness.
Employee attempted to remove cover on Digboi pump skid without verifying zero energy. Stored spring tension caused slight movement. Equipment isolated after near miss event.
Vehicle reversing on lease road without spotter, struck worker knee, ankle sprain treated in field clinic.

Operator delayed in entering control room after smoking break. Breathalyzer showed 0.08% alcohol level. Operator visited camp infirmary due to sudden vomiting. Incident recorded as recordable due to treatment beyond first aid. Assigned duties suspended immediately.
